scope: Baseline photo coverage before the crop completion update; historical records are dataset counts, not traffic, sales, volume or current quotes.

apiBehavior.note: The generated Chhattisgarh state file is not used by /api/crops?state=chhattisgarh.

mappingRules: Match explicit IDs; do not rely on substring or current Hindi labels.
Keep grains distinct from flour, whole pulses from dal, seeds from leaves, fresh crops from oils and dried products.
Do not use apple for custard apple or cowpea for cow.
Use neutral fallback for uncertain or broad categories such as other vegetables.
Do not claim all 263 missing national entries are distinct crops; list includes aliases, processed products, livestock and non-produce.
